item.title: Seattle victim shocked after man convicted in attack is released months shy of 1-year sentence
item.description: Just days after being sentenced to serve a year in jail, a man convicted of attacking two women is out.

item.title: Construction begins on new roundabout in Shoreline, WA
item.description: Drivers should be prepared for significant traffic disruptions to the North 145th Street corridor in Shoreline.

item.title: Reptile Zoo says goodbye to Monroe, WA community following attempts to save business
item.description: The Reptile Zoo in Monroe, Washington is finally closing after multiple attempts to save the beloved business. Presidents Day will be the last day of operations.

item.title: 20-year-old killed in rollover Tacoma, WA car crash
item.description: Four young people were in a car that rolled over during a crash in Tacoma over the weekend, one of the male occupants died.

item.title: Deadly condo fire displaces multiple Renton, WA families
item.description: One person is dead and multiple others were displaced from their homes on Monday following a fire at a condo complex in Renton.

item.title: 2 WA hikers rescued from Mt. Ellinor, airlifted to hospital by US Coast Guard
item.description: Two hikers have been successfully rescued from a mountainside after being injured over the weekend up on Mount Ellinor in Washington State.

item.title: Young 12's lost football at Seattle parade leads to call from Seahawk, community response
item.description: From heartbreak to the surprise of a lifetime! FOX 13 News has an update on 8-year-old Antonio Rodrigues who lost his signed football at the Seattle Seahawks World Champions Parade.

item.title: Family honoring Army Veteran Seahawks fan who died days before Super Bowl 2026
item.description: Defying doctor's expectations, one Army Veteran Seattle Seahawks fan hoped to cheer on the team during Super Bowl LX. He died days before the game. His family is now trying to get him back home.

item.title: Trump Accounts: What are they, do you need one? WA financial planner weighs in
item.description: One of the first commercials 130 million Americans saw as they tuned into the Superbowl this year was for an “Invest America" account, a local financial planner explains what they are.

item.title: Funding fight: WA advocates push to protect abortion access, transgender care in Olympia
item.description: Hundreds of advocates gathered on the Capitol steps in Olympia on Monday, urging lawmakers to restore funding for reproductive health care, transgender services and crime victim programs.
